name: Sarah Chen
title: Managing Partner
bio: Sarah Chen is the Managing Partner of Licit Axiom and leads the firm's Corporate and M&A practice groups. She has advised on transactions valued at over $50 billion throughout her career and is recognized as a leading corporate lawyer by Chambers & Partners.
publications: The Future of Cross-Border M&A (Harvard Business Review)
Corporate Governance Best Practices (Corporate Law Journal)

name: Michael Rodriguez
title: Senior Partner
bio: Michael Rodriguez leads our Litigation and Employment Law practices. He has successfully represented Fortune 500 companies in complex commercial disputes and class action litigation, recovering over $2 billion for clients.
publications: Employment Law in the Digital Age

name: Emily Thompson
title: Partner
experience: 15+ years in real estate and corporate law
bio: Emily Thompson specializes in complex real estate transactions and corporate structuring. She has closed over $10 billion in commercial real estate deals and advises major developers and REITs.
publications: Commercial Real Estate Due Diligence Guide

name: James Okonkwo
title: Partner
experience: 12+ years in IP and technology law
bio: James Okonkwo brings a unique combination of legal expertise and technical knowledge to our IP and Technology practice. He advises leading tech companies on patent portfolios, licensing, and technology transactions.
publications: AI and Intellectual Property: Legal Frameworks

name: Amanda Patel
title: Counsel
education: J.D., University of Chicago Law School
experience: 10+ years in securities and corporate law
bio: Amanda Patel advises public and private companies on securities offerings, corporate governance, and regulatory compliance. She has led numerous IPOs and debt offerings totaling over $15 billion.

name: David Kim
title: Associate
experience: 5+ years in M&A and private equity
bio: David Kim focuses on mergers and acquisitions and private equity transactions. He has worked on deals across various industries including technology, healthcare, and manufacturing.
